title: A Man Held His Breath for 24 Minutes and 37 Seconds

scenes.text: A man held his breath for 24 minutes and 37 seconds.
On March 27, 2021, a Croatian freediver set the world record.
He breathed pure oxygen first, which the rules allow.
Then he lay motionless in the water and held on.
24 minutes and 37 seconds, without a single breath.
That beat the old record by 34 seconds.
That's longer than a whole sitcom episode, on one breath.

description:
A Croatian freediver held his breath for 24 minutes and 37 seconds in 2021.
It's the Guinness record, after breathing pure oxygen first.
How long can you hold yours?
first_comment: 24 minutes on one breath. How long can you hold yours?
